title: Fanin bound for the XOR pair construction
statement: For every natural number $n$ and any two pairs of circuits $(p_1,p_2)$ and $(q_1,q_2)$ on $n$ variables, the maximum fanin of the two circuits produced by the XOR pair construction is at most the maximum of $2$ and the maximum fanin among the four input circuits.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ and $q$ are pairs of circuits on $n$ variables
